item.title: Salvation Army cancels downtown Columbia Christmas parade
item.description: The Salvation Army has canceled the annual downtown Columbia Christmas parade scheduled for Sunday, The District says.

item.title: Vodka bottle found in car involved in Oct. 28 Columbia DWI crash, court docs say
item.description: A vodka bottle was found in a vehicle that reportedly caused a crash on St. Charles Road in Columbia last month, court documents say.

item.title: Clifton City man dies after crashing into Cooper County creek
item.description: A Clifton City man suffered a medical emergency and died after his pickup truck ran off the road in Cooper County.

item.title: Forensic expert says Epstein was likely killed, but NYC medical examiner stands by suicide ruling
item.description: A forensics expert announced findings he says point to Jeffrey Epstein being killed in custody, contradicting the medical examiner's ruling.
